name: Hermit of the Natterknolls // Lone Wolf of the Natterknolls

faces.name: Hermit of the Natterknolls
faces.text:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell during your turn, draw a card.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if no spells were cast last turn, transform this creature.

faces.name: Lone Wolf of the Natterknolls
faces.text:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell during your turn, draw two cards.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform this creature.
